description: Check x402 Oracle server health, configured Base payTo posture, facilitator mode (demo or live), and seller-key safety flags. Free and read-only; requires no arguments or payment header. Use this before calling paid consult tools to verify availability; use oracle_pricing to inspect USD fees.
name: oracle_health

cdp_auth_configured.description: True when Coinbase CDP facilitator JWT credentials are configured.

demoMode.description: True when running with local DemoFacilitator verification.

ok.description: True when the Oracle server is healthy and accepting requests.

pay_to_configured.description: True when a valid 42-char settlement address is configured.

seller_leak_warning.description: True only if a dangerous buyer private key was detected in seller env.

service.description: Display name of the Oracle service.

wallet_configured.description: Always false on seller-only hosts (no spend key stored).
